text:
anna: Quick heads up - QA found the Console Observability quickstart rendering super slowly on preview. seems like a huge inline example + a couple of dead links.
jair: which example? the 'full-dashboard' JSON?
anna: yep, it's the full dashboard JSON embedded on the cost breakdown page. it's ~2MB and the static renderer pulls it all in.
leo: oof. we should switch to a small inline excerpt and link to the full JSON in /samples.
dena: agreed. also found two external links to third-party blog posts that 404. linkcheck flagged them.
anna: can we do an immediate triage plan? low-risk fixes ideally.
leo: plan: 1) truncate inline JSON to a concise snippet (~10 lines) showing the key fields 2) add a 'Download full sample' link pointing to /samples/observability/full-dashboard.json 3) replace broken external links with archived links or remove if non-essential.
jair: I'll open a small PR for the page edits (content + snippet) and mark it as docs/obs/trim-dashboard.
infra: docs-bot: preview site deploy queued for branch docs/obs/trim-dashboard
dena: heads-up on snippet: the tracing hook example also shows header name `traceid` but the SDK uses `X-Redwood-Trace` now. we should make them consistent and add a compatibility note.
leo: good catch. I'll update the Python and JS examples to use X-Redwood-Trace and include a one-liner about legacy header mapping.
anna: we also need to tidy the sample metadata (author + license) so it passes the site linter. last time it failed on missing license field.
jair: added to my PR checklist.
infra: docs-bot: build started for branch docs/obs/trim-dashboard
leo: small snippet patch (will be in PR):
```
# before
headers = {"traceid": trace}
# after
headers = {"X-Redwood-Trace": trace}
```
anna: please keep a short footnote: "Older integrations may still send `traceid`; Redwood maps this header to X-Redwood-Trace for backwards compatibility."
dena: for the two 404 external links, I found archived versions on the Wayback machine. should we point there or remove?
leo: prefer archive links if the content is essential for context, otherwise remove. which pages are they?
dena: 'best-practices-for-cost-aggregation' and 'open-telemetry-quick-hack' blog posts. I think the first is useful, link to archive; second is tangential, remove.
infra: docs-bot: build completed for branch docs/obs/trim-dashboard - linkcheck: 2 failures remaining
jair: thanks, will iterate. I'll also add a tiny redirect for the old internal doc link that keeps breaking: /internal/pricing -> /guides/pricing-summary (302 for now).
anna: who owns redirects? leo or infra?
leo: infra owns the redirect map but I'll coordinate. infra, can you add a temporary redirect?
infra: will add entry to redirects.yml and mark it as pending-legal.
anna: timeline - can we get this merged before Monday's scheduled docs release?
jair: aiming for EOD today. PR will be small and labeled docs-review.
leo: I'll review the snippet and SDK examples once PRs are up.
dena: i'll run a quick local linkcheck after merges.
infra: docs-bot: deploy queued for docs/obs/trim-dashboard -> preview site URL https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/obs/trim-dashboard
anna: excellent. thanks team — appreciate the quick turn. :raised_hands:
jair: opening PR now, ping when preview is live.
leo: ack, will check in a bit.
